intro: Football and sailing are big in Oman, along with traditional camel and horse racing.

chapters.title: Football
text: Oman won the Gulf Cup in 2009 and 2017. Goalkeeper Ali Al-Habsi played for years in the English Premier League.

chapters.title: Sailing
text: Oman has a strong sailing programme and hosts international races. Beach sports and the Tour of Oman cycling race are popular too.

keyTerms.meaning: A football tournament between Gulf countries.
